title: gaph_v2 pipeline parameters
description: GAPH v2 gene fetch and ortholog-to-target alignment workflow

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

stage.description: Pipeline stage to run. 'all' runs fetch, alignment, and annotation; 'align' runs alignment only from an existing fetch directory.

ids_file.description: Path to the input file containing gene IDs

fetch_dir.description: Directory containing fetched sequences and target context. Required if stage is 'align' or 'annotate'.

events_tsv.description: Path to events TSV for annotation stage

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

fetch_outdir.description: Output directory specifically for fetch stage results

align_outdir.description: Output directory specifically for alignment stage results

annotation_outdir.description: Output directory specifically for annotation stage results

alignment_strategies.description: Comma-separated alignment strategies to run, or 'all' for every strategy registered in the workflow

clinvar_vcf.description: Path to ClinVar VCF file for annotation. Defaults to CLINVAR_VCF, then assets/clinvar.vcf.gz when present, otherwise assets/no_clinvar.vcf.

chunk_size.description: Number of genes to process per chunk

target_annotation_gff3.description: Local NCBI RefSeq GFF3 for the target assembly. Defaults to GAPH_TARGET_ANNOTATION_GFF3, then assets/reference/ncbi/refseq/GCF_000001405.40_GRCh38.p14/genomic.gff.gz.

alignment_max_forks.description: Maximum concurrent tasks per alignment strategy process. With multiple strategies selected, total alignment concurrency can be higher and is also bounded by executor CPU/queue limits.

compact_alignment_events.description: Write final alignment_events.tsv.gz as unique event support rows instead of raw per-ortholog/per-strategy event rows. Raw remains the default.

ensembl_compara_maf_max_forks.description: Maximum concurrent Ensembl Compara MAF alignment tasks. Keep low for remote FTP streaming.

ensembl_compara_maf_release.description: Ensembl release label for the precomputed Compara MAF strategy.

ensembl_compara_maf_species_set.description: Ensembl Compara MAF species set directory/name.

ensembl_compara_maf_method.description: Compara method label written to alignment output metadata.

ensembl_compara_maf_manifest.description: Optional precomputed Ensembl Compara MAF chunk manifest. Defaults to ENSEMBL_COMPARA_MAF_MANIFEST when set, then assets/reference/ensembl/compara/release-<release>/<species_set>/ensembl_compara_maf_manifest.tsv.gz when present; otherwise the manifest is built during the run.

ensembl_compara_maf_base_url.description: HTTP(S) URL or local directory containing the selected Ensembl Compara MAF files.
